info.title: Areal Copilot Agents API
info.description: Endpoints used to list Copilot agents, read their status, read their tasks and change those tasks. Companion to the Areal Copilot Agents API integration guide.

post.description:
Login allows you to authenticate with the Areal API.
After successful login, you will receive an access token and a refresh token.
They will be set as cookies in the response.
After that, your subsequent requests to the API should
include the access token in the Cookie header or Authorization header.
In case of expiration, you can use the refresh token to get a new access token.
If MFA is enabled, you will receive a pre-auth token.
You can use the pre-auth token to complete the login process by calling the /mfa/verify/ endpoint.

Refresh will generate a new access token and refresh token.
Old ones will be invalidated. New cookies will be set in the response.
